When does New Year 2027 start in Nicaragua?

Nicaragua uses a single time zone on New Year's Eve, UTC-06:00, so the whole country welcomes 2027 at the same moment: midnight local time corresponds to 06:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Nicaragua in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Managua follows 20 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 5 hours after Managua.

When the clock strikes midnight in Managua, 190 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC-05:00): Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador (Quito), Mexico (Cancún), Panama and 5 more
  • Just after (UTC-07:00): Canada (Calgary), Mexico (Mazatlán) and United States (Denver)

Who celebrates at the same time as Nicaragua?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC-06:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Managua: Canada (Winnipeg), Costa Rica, Ecuador (Galápagos Islands), El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico (Mexico City), United States (Chicago) and Belize.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Nicaragua in UTC?

Midnight in Managua corresponds to 06:00 UTC on Friday, January 1, 2027.

How many time zones does Nicaragua have on New Year's Eve?

One. The whole country uses UTC-06:00 on New Year's Eve.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Nicaragua on New Year's Eve?

No. Managua keeps UTC-06:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Nicaragua?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC-05:00, which includes Brazil (Rio Branco), Canada (Toronto), Chile (Easter Island), Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador (Quito), Mexico (Cancún), Panama and 5 more.
